posts.title: The Weirdly Controversial History of the Monster Cereals: Count Chocula, Franken Berry and Boo Berry
posts.description: Count Chocula, Franken Berry and Boo Berry made breakfast a little spooky. Here is the strange, colourful history of General Mills' Monster Cereals.

posts.title: When Cartoons Have Agendas: Albert in Blunderland (1950)
posts.description: A 1950 cartoon about ants becomes a Cold War warning about state control, free enterprise and the limits of workplace cooperation.

posts.title: The Devil’s Brother: Laurel and Hardy Get the Operatic Treatment
posts.description: Laurel and Hardy take on opera in The Devil's Brother. Skip the songs and enjoy the comic chaos, classic routines and a new Warner Archive Blu-ray.
